category_edits.rationale: Across all four datasets, test whether reducing the causal pooled-state contribution from 20% to 15% reduces stale-interest interference. Retain the three-interaction half-life, padding exclusion, causal prefixes and final-real-position inference. Synchronize checkpoint metadata and the predictor writer; preserve all other settings and one GRU4Rec model per dataset.

change_summary: Change the shared causal GRU readout to 85% current state and 15% pooled state, retaining half-life 3 and synchronizing predictor metadata.
